d: Friends for the last 12 years, a successful duo in the music industry, and an integral part of the new chapter in Gujarati cinema, Sachin-Jigar are beloved figures, the heart and soul of all Gujaratis, known for composing soulful music.
Gujjubhai's father has found a new hobby: morning walks. See how this hobby makes Gujjubhai run for his life.
Chef Digna crafts delightful drinks and bites! Sip a cool Purple Glacier or sunny Guava Mocktail. Then, crunch into savory Raw Banana Bites. A perfect blend of flavors—a culinary journey with no end!

Chef Zhankhna brings a Mexican classic with a twist—Burrito in a Jar, layered with rice, beans, veggies, and bold spices. Followed by warm, comforting Bread Pudding, infused with cinnamon and cream. A savory-sweet duo, perfect for any day!

Chef Dr. Bindu creates a healthy Non-Fry Palak Kofta, vibrant and full of flavor. Then enjoy creamy Pumpkin Cheese Macaroni, the ultimate comfort dish. Two nutritious recipes, crafted with care and bursting with taste!
Girishkumar's father is obsessed with films. Can Girishkumar banish this cinematic ghost and restore normalcy? Find out!

When IPS Officer ACP Samrat and a Special Action Team are assigned a special mission to catch Liquor Mafia Gajraj, who is operating an illegal liquor business in a dry state, a bigger war begins between ACP and the Liquor Mafia.

This episode features Atul Mahida's incredible talent of creating a variety of sounds using just his mouth, including a western music orchestra. Comedian Deep Bhatt also entertains viewers with his hilarious 12th-grade jokes.

Mahesh Vaidya shares humorous tales of Gujaratis' obsession with American visas in this episode, while comedian Kamlesh Darji's tales of comedic mishaps in front of villagers leave viewers in stitches!

A slight misunderstanding disrupts the brotherly bond, leading to a lasting rift fueled by pride of younger brother. Despite the passage of years, bitterness persists. Explore how other family members work to reunite the estranged brothers for a happy resolution.
